items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I remember him. ... I remember one period there in the twenties, largely due to a man named Benjamin Stevenson... They called him Steve... he was one of the most marvelous football players of the day

ctx.x: No, that's right. But oh, Stevenson --
it took more than two men to tackle Stevenson. Fabulous football player.
